title: Switch: move open pull requests to develop, refresh the clone and tell running agents
summary: After the default branch became develop, checked no open pull request still targeted main, pointed the main checkout's origin/HEAD at develop, warned the one other local session, and merged the changelog line with the switch report.
friction: tests/wsl.sh could not start on this computer (the WSL distro has no bash), so the full suite ran only in CI; a machine-setup check would catch it before a run relies on it
